He expressed confidence that the **BJP** would form the next government and asserted his intention to return for the oath-taking ceremony after May 4th.  **Modi** accused the ruling **TMC** of presiding over “syndicate raj”, political violence, and economic decline, while promising employment opportunities for youth and a focus on restoring West Bengal's prosperity. He also appealed to Matua voters, assuring them of citizenship rights and protection against illegal infiltration.

recent_articles.title: BJP attacking Bengali culture, pride: Kejriwal; Modi won’t have his way in Bengal: Tejashwi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Arvind Kejriwal**, former Delhi Chief Minister and convener of the **Aam Aadmi Party**, joined the Trinamool Congress campaign in West Bengal on Sunday, addressing three rallies in Kolkata and Howrah.  His visit coincides with the final days of campaigning for the second phase of the Assembly elections, scheduled to conclude Monday evening. The AAP recently experienced a setback as seven of its MPs switched to the **Bharatiya Janata Party**.

recent_articles.title: Will take strict action against officials who hold up files for more than a month, says Bihar CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Samrat Choudhary**, the Chief Minister of **Bihar**, visited his ancestral village, Lakhanpur, on Sunday (April 26, 2026).  During a public meeting in Munger, he addressed concerns about red-tape and promised strict action against officials delaying file processing. He also emphasized his government's goal of providing basic amenities to all residents and ensuring accessible government services for everyone.

recent_articles.title: Rodents destroy currency notes seized in corruption case, Supreme Court expresses surprise - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** expressed surprise that currency notes seized from an accused in a Bihar corruption case were destroyed by rodents. Justices J. B. Pardiwala and K. V. Viswanathan questioned how many such notes are lost due to improper storage, calling it a "huge revenue loss" for the state. The court granted bail to the woman convicted of accepting a ₹10,000 bribe but suspended her sentence after noting that the seized currency was destroyed by rodents in the 'Malkhana'.

recent_articles.title: Samrat Choudhary approves funds for 75 ITI in first Cabinet meeting as Bihar CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary** approved several initiatives during his first Cabinet meeting, including the establishment of 75 state-of-the-art Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) under the **PM SETU** scheme. The Cabinet also sanctioned ₹305 crore for an 11-acre research park at IIT Patna and an additional grant of ₹39 crore for phase 2 of the Incubation Centre at IIT Patna.  The State Cabinet also decided to develop 11 new satellite townships in the state, prohibiting land sales and construction until a Master Plan is prepared.

recent_articles.title: Govt claims women winning unreserved panchayat seats in ‘significant numbers’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Union Government** celebrated National Panchayati Raj Day, highlighting the progress of women's reservation in Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs).  While the Constitution mandates a 33% quota for women in urban and rural local bodies, 19 states have extended this provision to reserve 50% seats for women. However, data shows that the actual number of women representatives exceeds the prescribed quota in only 10 states/union territories, while four others fail to meet it.  The Ministry emphasized the increasing representation of women in PRIs, but acknowledged discrepancies between mandated and achieved quotas across various states.

recent_articles.title: Pakistan out of women’s football tournament in India over political strife | Football News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pakistan**'s women's football team will not participate in the **South Asian Football Federation (SAFF)** Women’s Championship hosted in India due to ongoing geopolitical tensions between the two nations. The Pakistani government has barred the team from traveling, citing a lack of an NOC from relevant authorities.  The tournament is scheduled for May 25 to June 7 and will be held at Goa's Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium. This decision follows a long history of strained relations between India and **Pakistan**, which have impacted cross-border travel for athletes in various sports, including cricket.

recent_articles.title: Kejriwal asks people of Tamil Nadu not to vote for NDA, says BJP has captured AIADMK - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Arvind Kejriwal**, leader of the **Aam Aadmi Party**, criticized the **AIADMK** for bringing the **BJP** to Tamil Nadu, claiming it would lead to the dismantling of the party and a loss of progress. He warned voters against supporting the BJP or the AIADMK, stating that their policies would halt the good work being done by the **DMK** government in Tamil Nadu.  Kejriwal praised **M.K. Stalin**, the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, for his initiatives like the "Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme" and monthly stipends for women and girls.

recent_articles.title: JD(U) authorises Nitish Kumar to select new Bihar legislature party leader - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nitish Kumar**, the former Chief Minister of Bihar, resigned from his position and was authorized by **the Janata Dal (United)** to select a new leader for their legislature party. The decision was made unanimously during a meeting held at 1, Anne Marg, with **Neeraj Kumar**, JD(U) chief spokesperson, confirming the authorization.

recent_articles.title: Poll bugle to fall silent across Tamil Nadu on Tuesday evening - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Political parties** in Tamil Nadu are concluding their intense campaigning ahead of the Assembly election on April 23rd.  Polling will begin at 7 a.m. that day, with all political functionaries and party workers not eligible to vote required to vacate the area by 6 p.m. on Tuesday. **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Rahul Gandhi**, and other prominent leaders from various parties have campaigned in the state, while the Chief Electoral Officer has outlined strict regulations for the period leading up to the election.  These include restrictions on public gatherings, vehicle usage, and the establishment of polling booths.

recent_articles.title: West Bengal election: Why politicians are campaigning with fish in hand
recent_articles.rephrased_article: In the upcoming West Bengal assembly elections, **Indian politicians** are using fish as a political symbol to appeal to voters.  The BJP is attempting to counter accusations of interfering with Bengali culture by highlighting their own connection to fish consumption and local production. The ruling Trinamool Congress accuses the BJP of trying to restrict fish consumption, while the BJP claims that the Trinamool Congress has failed to provide Bengal with enough fish. Both parties are using fish as a way to appeal to voters' cultural identities and anxieties about food security.

recent_articles.title: ​A plan of change: On Bihar politics and the BJP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Samrat Choudhary**, a former member of the Rashtriya Janata Dal and Janata Dal (United), was sworn in as the 24th Chief Minister of Bihar on April 15, 2026.  This marks the first time a politician from the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** has held the office. The BJP's strategy for growth involved outgrowing regional partners and shifting power dynamics within the state, culminating in Choudhary's appointment after years of maneuvering.  The move signifies a shift in Bihar's political landscape as the BJP seeks to solidify its hold on the OBC-EBC base that was previously held by **Nitish Kumar**.

recent_articles.title: DMK regime has created respect for women, says Stalin - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M. K. Stalin** asserted that his government has prioritized women's empowerment through measures like mobility, financial support, education and healthcare, while criticizing the **BJP** and **AIADMK** for rejecting key infrastructure projects in Coimbatore.  He also accused former minister S. P. Velumani of corruption during his tenure, and highlighted the DMK’s commitment to social justice by including Kongu Vellalar communities in the Backward Classes list. **Tejashwi Yadav**, Leader of Opposition in the Bihar Legislative Assembly and national working president of the Rashtriya Janata Dal, praised Stalin's leadership and emphasized the importance of a "philosophy" when voting for the DMK-led alliance.

recent_articles.title: 26 candidates bag perfect 100 NTA score in JEE-Main - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **NTA** announced that 26 candidates achieved a perfect score of 100 on the JEE-Main entrance exam, surpassing last year's total.  Over 13 lakh candidates took the exam in two sessions, with more than eight lakh appearing in both. The scores are normalized across shifts and range from 100 to 0 for each shift. The candidates, all males, hail from various states including Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Rajasthan, Delhi, Maharashtra, Haryana, Chandigarh, Bihar, Tamil Nadu, Odisha, and Gujarat.

recent_articles.title: Edappadi Palaniswami interview: We know how to bring debt under control and implement all welfare schemes, says AIADMK leader - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Edappadi K. Palaniswami**, leader of the AIADMK, spoke to The Hindu about the upcoming Tamil Nadu Assembly elections and his party's alliance with the BJP. He addressed criticism from **M.K. Stalin**, Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, regarding the delimitation bill and the 33% quota for women in Parliament and Legislative Assemblies. Palaniswami emphasized that the AIADMK will form a government and provide good governance. He also discussed his party's campaign strategy and its alliance with the BJP, stating they are united in their goal of ousting the DMK.  The article highlights Palaniswami's stance on youth empowerment and his party's efforts to attract young voters.

recent_articles.title: SIR is a bloodless massacre, says Parakala Prabhakar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Parakala Prabhakar**, a political and economic analyst, criticized the proposed **Special Integrated Revision (SIR)** of electoral rolls in Telangana, calling it a "bloodless massacre" that threatens democratic rights. He questioned the need for a fresh revision when the annual Special Summary Revision (SSR) is already in place, criticizing the **Election Commission of India**'s justification and lack of transparency regarding irregularities and data released. Prabhakar cited examples from other states where SIR resulted in voter deletions with unclear criteria and inconsistencies, urging the government to first prepare the voter list through the State Election Commission before implementing SIR.

recent_articles.title: BLOs disappointed over paltry pay for hectic SIR work - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Booth Level Officers (BLOs)** in Kerala are expressing disappointment over a ₹2,000 payment for their work during the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. This is significantly lower than the ₹6,000 incentive offered in Bihar last year and has left many BLOs feeling betrayed. The payments have not been distributed to all constituencies, with many claiming they do not even cover their out-of-pocket expenses.  BLOs were responsible for mapping existing voter rolls against the base list of 2002, conducting field visits, and verifying information before the enumeration phase from November 4 to December 18.

recent_articles.title: Chhattisgarh Vedanta power plant blast: Death toll rises to 24 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A blast at the Vedanta power plant in Chhattisgarh's Sakti district has tragically claimed 24 lives, with one more fatality reported on Sunday.  **Vedanta Ltd.** workers were injured when a steel tube carrying high-pressure steam exploded, leaving several others critically burned. **Anil Agarwal**, chairman of **Vedanta Group**, and **Devendra Patel**, plant head, are among eight to ten individuals named in an FIR filed by police for causing death by negligence.  The incident is under investigation by both the police and state authorities.

recent_articles.title: Bihar CM slams opposition over women's quota bill - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary** criticized the opposition parties for their refusal to support an amendment to the women's reservation bill, calling it a "black day" and vowing retaliation. **Sanjay Saraogi**, state party president of the BJP, announced that the party's women's wing would hold a protest on April 20th against the opposition's stance. The amendment, which grants 33% reservation to women in Parliament, was passed by an overwhelming majority in 2023 but faced opposition from non-NDA parties who were wary of its link with delimitation.

recent_articles.title: Daylight bank heist in Singrauli: One accused held; M.P. police launch manhunt in four States - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kamlesh Kumar**, an accused in a bank robbery of over ₹15 crore in Madhya Pradesh's Singrauli, was arrested by the **Railway Protection Force (RPF)** near Aurangabad's Nabinagar station on Saturday. Kumar was found in suspicious condition and questioned before being apprehended.  Cash worth ₹15 lakh and some gold were recovered from him.

recent_articles.title: JD(U) likely to elect new head of legislature party at Patna meet on April 20 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **JD(U)** is expected to elect a new legislature leader on April 20, 2026, following the resignation of **Nitish Kumar**, who was replaced by **Samrat Choudhary**. The meeting will be held in Patna at **Kumar's** new address. Speculation surrounds senior leader **Vijay Kumar Chaudhary**, currently one of two Deputy Chief Ministers, as a possible candidate for the position.  The party post has been vacant since **Kumar's** resignation on April 14th.

recent_articles.title: Cash incentives for women steer Bengal poll discourse - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: With less than seven days until the first phase of voting in West Bengal, **Trinamool Congress** and **Bharatiya Janata Party** are vying for women's votes with their respective welfare schemes. The **Trinamool Congress**’s Lakshmir Bhandar program has been a successful model for the party, offering ₹1,500 per month to eligible women.  The BJP countered with its Matri Shakti Vandan Yojana promising ₹3,000 per month, leading to clashes between supporters of both parties. **Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee** criticized the BJP's tactics and accused them of collecting voter information for undue advantage. The BJP defended their actions, stating that they were simply offering a better scheme than the Trinamool’s previous program.

recent_articles.title: It’ a red-letter day, says Revanth; KTR blames BJP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following the defeat of the Women's Reservation Bill in Parliament, **Congress** and **Bharatiya Rashtra Samithi (BRS)** leaders praised opposition parties for uniting to block the controversial legislation.  **Rahul Gandhi**, **Mallikarjun Kharge**, and **A. Revanth Reddy** led the charge against the bill, with **K. T. Rama Rao** blaming the BJP for its failure. **Bandi Sanjay** accused the Congress of using the bill to weaken southern India, while **N Ramchander Rao** criticized the bill's defeat as a setback for women's empowerment.

recent_articles.title: Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary launches self-enumeration phase of Census 2027 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary** launched the self-enumeration phase of Census 2027 from the Chief Minister’s Secretariat, urging citizens to participate in the process. The initiative will be conducted digitally from April 17th to May 1st and includes a House Listing Operations (HLO) phase from May 2nd to May 31st. **Mr. Choudhary** emphasized the importance of accurate data for good governance and development plans, while **former Chief Minister Nitish Kumar** also completed his self-enumeration.  The web-based platform allows citizens to enter their family details online at their convenience.

recent_articles.title: What are the costs of population decline? The Hindu Explains - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Andhra Pradesh** and **Tamil Nadu** Chief Ministers have expressed concerns about the low fertility rates in their states.  **Chandrababu Naidu**, of Andhra Pradesh, plans to introduce legislation to incentivize more children per family. The decline in total fertility rates across India has been particularly pronounced in southern and some northern states, with **Andhra Pradesh**, **Telangana**, **Kerala**, **Punjab**, and **Himachal Pradesh** recording rates of 1.5 or lower.  This trend contrasts with states like Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, and Madhya Pradesh which have higher fertility rates.

recent_articles.title: Muslims the target? Fury as millions lose voting rights in India’s Bengal | Elections News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Election Commission of India (ECI)** revised its electoral rolls in West Bengal, resulting in the deletion of voter names from over nine million people. The process, called a special intensive revision (SIR), has been controversial and is accused by opposition parties and Muslim groups of targeting voters unlikely to vote for Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).  The ECI claims the SIR aims to remove duplicate or deceased voters but critics argue it disproportionately affects Muslims. The process has faced legal challenges, with the Supreme Court allowing those whose cases are pending before tribunals to vote in the upcoming election. Muslim families across West Bengal report difficulties proving their voting rights, citing discrepancies in spellings, changes of surnames after marriage, and issues with residency status.  The ECI maintains that the SIR is a routine activity but critics argue it lacks transparency and places an excessive burden on female voters who often lack required documents.

recent_articles.title: Beneath the euphoria, Bihar’s first BJP Chief Minister faces several significant challenges - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Newly sworn-in **Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary**, a former Deputy Chief Minister in the previous Nitish Kumar government, faces significant challenges as he assumes leadership of Bihar.  **Choudhary**, who joined the BJP in 2017 after a career in opposition parties, must navigate complex coalition dynamics and match the political persona of his predecessor while managing high expectations from the people. He also needs to address financial mismanagement, communal harmony concerns, and doubts about his abilities within the BJP and its ideological parent organization, the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS).  **Choudhary** will need to establish his administrative capabilities in a state known for groupism among bureaucrats and broaden the BJP's voter base while maintaining alliances with existing parties.

recent_articles.title: Watch: Delimitation controversy & Bihar’s first BJP CM | Above the Fold | 15.04.2026 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mallikarjun Kharge**, President of the **AICC** and Leader of Opposition in Rajya Sabha, announced that the **INDIA** bloc has unanimously decided to oppose the Delimitation Bill.  The death toll from the Sakti power plant explosion in Chhattisgarh rose to 16, while **Samrat Choudhary** was sworn in as Bihar's first BJP Chief Minister. Registration for the Amarnath Yatra is now open, starting July 3rd.

recent_articles.title: Implications of increasing the size of the Lok Sabha - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The government** has introduced three Bills related to delimitation and women's reservation, which are expected to be debated in the extended Budget session from April 16-18. The **Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill** proposes increasing the Lok Sabha size, adjusting seat distribution based on population proportions, and clarifying that women's reservation will take effect after delimitation. The **Delimitation Bill** establishes a commission with provisions similar to those in 2002, requiring the latest Census for delimitation.  The third Bill extends these provisions to three Union Territories.

recent_articles.title: Samrat Choudhary sworn in as Bihar’s first BJP CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Samrat Choudhary**, newly elected leader of the **National Democratic Alliance (NDA)**, was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Bihar on Wednesday.  He was accompanied by two senior JD(U) leaders, **Bijendra Prasad Yadav** and **Vijay Kumar Choudhary**, who are expected to serve as Deputy CMs. The swearing-in ceremony took place at Lok Bhawan with prominent figures from the BJP and former CM Nitish Kumar in attendance.  The new government is expected to expand after the results of upcoming state elections.

recent_articles.title: Delimitation is the BJP’s tool to divide Bengal and India, says Mamata - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee**, Chief Minister of West Bengal, accused the **BJP** led Union Government of attempting to divide India and West Bengal through a delimitation bill.  She claimed the bill is politically motivated and intended to benefit the BJP by manipulating demographics and potentially merging districts with neighboring states.  Banerjee also stated that the delimitation process will be followed by the National Register of Citizens (NRC) and would lead to further voter suppression and displacement.

recent_articles.title: Higher vote share for Vijay could workto the DMK’s advantage, says CPI Tamil Nadu secretary - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **M. Veerapandian**, secretary of the **CPI Tamil Nadu**, believes the ruling **DMK-led alliance** is poised for a landslide victory, surpassing even Chief Minister **M.K. Stalin's** predictions. He attributes this to the strong support for the alliance among voters who are drawn to its welfare measures and commitment to unity. While actor **C. Joseph Vijay's TVK** party draws crowds, Veerapandian believes it lacks the organizational strength to translate popularity into votes.  He argues that the DMK-led alliance is gaining ground in rural areas due to its door-to-door campaigning efforts.

recent_articles.title: Centre moots inter-State redistribution of Lok Sabha seats based on 2011 Census - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Centre** is proposing constitutional amendments that would change the distribution of Lok Sabha seats based on the 2011 census, potentially reducing the representation of some states. The **Congress** and other opposition parties are criticizing these proposals as a backdoor attempt to redistribute seats for political gain ahead of the 2029 elections.  The proposed changes would increase the size of the Lok Sabha from 550 to a maximum of 850 seats, with an additional redistribution based on population shifts since 1971. The **Centre** argues that these changes are necessary to implement the 33% reservation for women in Parliament.
